name: World of Tanks
verdict: Game developed by Wargaming, controlled by founder Victor Kislyi. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Wargaming is a private Cyprus-based company; press reporting (Bloomberg via GameSpot, 2016) put control with Victor Kislyi (64% direct plus his father's 25.5%). No state or fund ownership found, no human-rights finding found. Kislyi-stake figures date from 2016.
